document: Plan2001-O universal five-operation object ABI (CREATE/OPEN/CLOSE/BIND/INVOKE), libc wrappers, TCP6/ObjectFIFO/GE and UDP6 provider tests
status: implemented candidate: VOBJ*/TCP6* and 27 dead pathname/FD slots reserved; persistent GE/O added to the five-call ABI; UDP6 provider candidate; 2026-11-05 Pipe/UART/KBD provider candidate moves the native byte streams and exclusive PS/2 claim under the same five-call ABI without a new syscall; 2026-11-05 USB metadata-service candidate adds ObjOpenUsb/ObjOpUsbList over the existing usbcore_list snapshot without a new syscall or endpoint-handle unification; 2026-11-05 USB endpoint-open candidate adds ObjOpUsbEpOpen=21/VkindUsbEp=10 behind an eve-only Vcreate gate and fixes >256-record direct ObjOpUsbList capacity handling; 2026-11-05 phase-3 retirement removes the 16 Pipe/KBD/UART/PIPEINHERIT handler symbols (71-85,100) leaving them RESERVED with nil dispatch; Pipe/UART/KBD are reached only through OBJCREATE/OPEN/INVOKE/CLOSE with ObjOpPipeInherit=22 and ObjOpUartCount=23; table 135 named / 71 active / 64 reserved; 2026-11-05 phase-4 retirement removes the five NET6* UDP6 handler symbols (116-120) leaving them RESERVED with nil dispatch; address lookup is OBJINVOKE(ObjOpNet6Addr=24) and all UDP6 use is the five OBJ calls; table 135 named / 66 active / 69 reserved

source_baseline.work_started_from: actual current working tree containing the prior OpenCode candidates (volatile objects/ObjectFIFO and cross-process unified VOBJ/TCP6/GE); the 2026-11-02 read-only MCP snapshot was not used to overwrite it
source_baseline.tree_state: not a version-control repository; no branch operation or publication was performed

identity_scope.volatile: RAM-only per-boot identity; no GE/O read/write on creation
identity_scope.persistent: GE/O v1 identity (VolumeUUID, SpaceID, OID) unchanged
identity_scope.raw_oid_lookup: not provided; a Handle or an explicit GEnamespace role with an O Space capability is required

bind.role: bounded ASCII label, never a path or directory component
bind.effect: named visibility only; not storage identity, FIFO subscription or packet routing
bind.ge_mirror: also installed through octxbindmode in the native O process view, so OLOOKUP and NS1-NS4 copy/share/revocation apply

capability_rights.authority_rule: derived from the Handle; ObjCall.rights must be zero and never widens authority
capability_rights.delegation: OBJOPEN(ObjOpenHandle), OBJGRANT/ObjOpGrant, and OSPAWN flags=2 copy only an equal or attenuated subset
capability_rights.implicit_inheritance: none; no PID+handle-number shortcut, no rfork/exec inheritance
capability_rights.udp6_rights: Vread receives, Vwrite sends; default Vread|Vwrite|Vmeta|Vdelegate; subsets only

objectfifo.message: one ordered, complete authorized object reference plus optional 0..64 byte opaque envelope
objectfifo.fanout: independent per-subscription bounded queue and cursor (TEE)
objectfifo.overflow: drop oldest per subscription with dropped counter
objectfifo.receiver: blocking with timeout, non-blocking option, wake on close/revoke

cross_process.mechanism: OSPAWN flags bit 2 + struct Oinheritv, explicit attenuation
cross_process.rights_rule: 0 copies parent rights; otherwise requested rights must be a subset
cross_process.child_discovery: plan9.obj_list() (OBJINVOKE List) returns process Handles in slot order
cross_process.lifetime: message/Handle Vobj reference owns the TCP Tendpoint; accepting process may exit before the receiver serves
cross_process.evidence: parent pid 3; worker pid 17 accepted, published GE+TCP through ObjectFIFO, exited (WAIT (17, '')); parent served HTTP 200

tcp_provider.legacy_shims: TCP6LISTEN(108), TCP6CONNECT(109), TCP6ACCEPT(110), TCP6READ(111), TCP6WRITE(112), TCP6CLOSE(113) delegate to the same core
tcp_provider.stream_semantics: unchanged; ObjectFIFO preserves reference/message boundaries only

ge_capability.open: OBJOPEN(ObjOpenGe) with an existing O Space Handle and OID
ge_capability.authorization: oscopycap makes an independent Ohand capability copy with the same SpaceID and rights; oauthorize checks revoked/rights but skips source-process view membership
ge_capability.identity: persistent SpaceID/OID and volume UUID in VobjInfo; not remapped to a new volatile OID
ge_capability.bind: OBJBIND mirrors an attenuated capability into the native O view
ge_capability.not_a_clone: OBJINVOKE read/write resolves through onativeget/onativeput on the persistent provider
ge_capability.caveat: a delegated GE capability is closed by its Handles; later namespace/OREVOKE edits do not retroactively revoke it

compatibility.vobj: 121-135 RETIRED/RESERVED: nil systab entries, sysreserved=1, sysvobj* wrappers removed; Python method names are OBJ* adapters
compatibility.tcp6: 108-113 RETIRED/RESERVED: nil systab entries, sysreserved=1, systcp6* wrappers removed; vtcp_* stays internal
compatibility.dead_path_fd: 16 pathname/FS and 11 always-failing FD slots RESERVED with nil systab entries and Ebadarg; no sysunsupported special case
compatibility.udp6: 116-120 RETIRED/RESERVED: nil systab entries, sysreserved=1, sysnet6* wrappers removed; address lookup is ObjOpNet6Addr=24; endpoints/data use ObjOpenUdp6/SendTo/RecvFrom/CLOSE
compatibility.ge: OVOLOPEN/OSPACE*/OEXECUTE, native namespace and OQUERY unchanged; GE/O v1 bytes and OIDs unchanged
